attention.scope: Real original eager first-step first joint block, positive and optional negative conditions; resident GPU only; excludes loading/offload/other blocks/later steps/VAE.
attention.method: Actual Q/K/V retained in memory by wrapping original runtime.attention during original eager _block; no saved tensor data or precision conversion.
attention.no_math: An outer supported sdpa_kernel context enables FLASH/EFFICIENT/CUDNN with normal PyTorch priority for every full-shape call, including current/capture. Each explicit backend is singleton-forced. Full MATH is never enabled by this benchmark.
attention.timing: CUDA events; repeated warmed batches; contiguous variants include Q/K/V conversion every call. Whole block includes output reshape cost.
